newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen Vienna's top loser after H1.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen Vienna's top loser after H1.

text.p: Shares in Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien were the top loser in early trading after the company announced lower-than-expected earnings for the first half, traders said.
At 0804 GMT, Flughafen was down 4.19 percent, or 30 schillings at 686 making them by far the blue-chip ATX index's largest loser so far this morning. The ATX index was down 0.47 percent.
Flughafen was also the most active stock on turnover of 30,810 lots.
"It could go down to 680. Then it depends on whether investors take fright and further selling kicks in," said one trader.
Earlier, Flughafen said pre-tax profit fell to 389 million schillings in the first six months from 407 million in the year-ago period.
Moreover, it cautioned it did not expect full-year earnings to match levels posted in 1995. -- Julia Ferguson, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
